fusion_rules.missing_value_note: Missing environmental observations are preserved as NaN. No forward-fill, interpolation or imputation is permitted. Per-source <source>_observed flags and <source>_observation_age_days columns make the missingness visible instead of manufacturing a value.
fusion_rules.min_matched_rows_rationale: Same threshold as aerosphinx.tracks.workstream_c group comparisons. A source with fewer matched rows is reported but flagged as insufficient evidence; Phase 5's MERRA-2 group had 5 matched test rows and was declared untestable on that basis.

objective: Track B ablations using fused availability mask
